githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 incorporates upstream v0.1.4 and adds macOS 26 compatibility.

## Compatibility

- Added macOS 26 compatibility while preserving newer behavior on macOS 27.
- Removed the fork's dependency on nightly builds and the nightly source branch.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.3...v0.1.5](https://github.com/waruhachi/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.3...v0.1.5)
